// diagnostic

E0136

A runtime value constructed into a range type without the fallible `?` form (D-RANGETYPE1)

What

A runtime value constructed into a range type without the fallible `?` form (D-RANGETYPE1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0136

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0136: tests/ui/inline_range_runtime_needs_try.stderr.

Error [E0136]: making a `Int(0..100)` from a runtime value can fail
  --> tests/ui/inline_range_runtime_needs_try.jet:3:35
    |
  3 |     value :: Int(0..100).from_int(raw)
    |                                   ^^^
 Why: only a literal is checked at compile time; a runtime number needs the fallible form so a bad value is handled
 Fix: write `Int(0..100).from_int(raw)?` and handle the failure
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0136
